rules.title: Precipitation chances and stronger winds coincide
rules.threshold: In the same hourly forecast: precipitation chance at least 60% and forecast sustained wind or range maximum at least 25 mph. These are VentusIQ planning thresholds, not NWS warning criteria.
rules.mechanism: The hourly outlook contains both precipitation chances and stronger wind. It does not quantify their joint probability, precipitation intensity or wind gusts.
rules.action: Inspect nearby hours in the activity planner and check official warnings before outdoor activities or driving.
rules.coverage_note: 48.0 of 48 upcoming hours contain the fields needed for this rule. Missing hours are not favorable conditions.

compound.limitations: Changes in selected source-overlap rules, not observed impacts, joint probabilities or all-clear conditions. Forecast rules use 48 hours; measured air is an observation instant. Normalized premise evidence is retained; raw products follow their own archive retention.

metadata.name: St. Johns River near Deland

impacts.statement: Major flooding occurs to many structures and marinas along the river and in the Hontoon Island area.
Water starts to enter low lying buildings around Hontoon Island. Many secondary roads and homes in low lying areas are flooded.
Water moves into yards and approaches buildings around Hontoon Island.
Docks and piers are completely submerged at Pier 44 Marina. Many docks are partially submerged at Hontoon Landing Marina.
Flooding of campsites and trails occurs at Hontoon Island State Park.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

metadata.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
